}}'''Marline''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Marline}}

== Appearance ==
She has purple twilight colored eyes and dark brown hair, which she is proud of as it is a rarity among the Aiel. She is as tall as most men. She looks to be around the same age as Rand, but is about 20 years older.

==Strength and Abilities==
Marline can [[channel]] with a bit of strength. In TWoTC her strength level is described as {{opsl|34}}, which is a middle ranking level among [[Aes Sedai]].

This strength is not enough to open alone a gateway for [[Travel]]ing.

== Activities ==
She is among the six Wise Ones that [[Traveling|Travel]] to [[Ghealdan]] with [[Perrin Aybara]] to keep an eye out on [[Seonid Traighan]] and [[Masuri Sokawa]].

She accompanies Perrin to have a look over the [[Shaido]] camp in [[Malden]].

In the making of ''[[Mah'alleinir]]'' by Perrin he is helped with the [[One Power]] provided by [[Neald]], [[Grady]] and all six the Wise Ones in his camp.

Later it can be assumed that she stays along [[Edarra]] with Perrin's forces in the [[Field of Merrilor]] to prepare for the [[Last Battle]] and then she fights in their campaigns.
